build_ClsHead: build a ClsHead classification head with CrossEntropyLoss and configurable top-k accuracy settings
test_ClsHead_loss: test the ClsHead loss method to compute classification loss from backbone features and data samples
test_ClsHead_predict: test the ClsHead predict method to generate softmax predictions and predicted labels from features
review_ClsHead_pre_logits: review the ClsHead pre_logits method that extracts the last stage feature from backbone outputs
refactor_ClsHead_get_predictions: refactor the ClsHead _get_predictions method to customize softmax post-processing and label assignment
